title: Where did Room Twelve go?
situation: Mr. Cache wants his favourite room from years ago, but the Token Hotel has changed, and Room Twelve is missing.

goals.Mr. Cache: To sleep in Room Twelve again, exactly as it was, with the swan bathtub.
goals.Lady Token: To get a room for the lowest possible number of tokens and say as few words as possible.
goals.Pierce: To find Room Twelve and keep both guests happy without apologizing more than twice in a row.
goals.Vex: To serve a drink in peace, and quietly to make sure Mr. Cache gets his room.
goals.Madame Halloran: To restore order in the lobby before any guest notices that anything is wrong.

secrets.Pierce: He moved the Room Twelve bed into the lobby last week to make space, and he forgot to tell anyone.
